description: Builds a pilot plan for one workflow, typically the first one prioritize_automation_workflows recommends, from 11 caller-supplied facts. Returns pilot steps, review gates, acceptance checks and a Markdown plan. It does not connect accounts, start provider work, store a plan, send messages or execute the workflow.

constraints.description: Limits the plan must respect. Optional.

currentSteps.description: Today's steps in order, 1 to 8, in the user's words.

desiredOutput.description: The result the user wants at the end.

destinationSystem.description: System the approved result goes to, e.g. QuickBooks.

inputDescription.description: The inputs the workflow reads, as the user describes them.

reviewOwner.description: Person or role who approves drafts before they are used.

riskLevel.description: Cost of a wrong output: low, medium or high, as the user judges it.

sensitiveData.description: True if the inputs include personal, financial, health or confidential data.

sourceSystem.description: System the inputs come from, e.g. Gmail.

successChecks.description: 1 to 6 checks that show the pilot worked, from the user.

systemsAlreadyUsed.description: Other tools the team already uses. Optional.

trigger.description: What starts the workflow, e.g. 'a supplier invoice email arrives'.

workflowName.description: Short name of the workflow, as the user calls it.
